about_the_game:
Lies are a poisoned chalice for evading responsibility; in the end, they ferment into a debt that can never be repaid.

《Your Takeout》 is an exploratory decryption walking simulation psychological horror game, built using the latest technology of the Unreal Engine 5 game engine and super realistic single player first person. Developed independently by a game enthusiast, this game features a portable camera perspective, realistic graphics, and spatial sound reverberation effects to provide players with an immersive experience.

Gameplay

🔎

If everything is as usual, then you are safe. Put down the takeout and end this order.

🔎

If there is an abnormality, please ride your bike immediately to escape!

If you can persist for 8 days, perhaps you can get rid of all of this.

Game Introduction

Due to financial constraints, I took on a part-time job at Little Pig Waimai after work.

I don't remember when the abnormality started, nor do I remember when the headache started.

I can no longer distinguish whether it is an illusion or reality, but when the illusion cannot dissipate and engulf reality, the situation changes.

I must escape immediately!

Are you ready to face the truth at the boundary between reality and illusion?

《Your Takeout》is a short and intense horror game that lasts approximately 60 to 120 minutes, inspired by abnormal experience games such as" Exit 8 ". You can experience the hallucinations experienced by the protagonist who suffers from mental illness.

short_description: Due to financial difficulties, you’ve taken a part-time job delivering takeout. Some orders seem unusual. Stay alert, distinguish between what’s normal and what’s not, and deliver the orders on time — or just escape.
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, French, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
